stories.description: Threat actors accessed databases containing customer information associated with clinics in Japan.

stories.title: Hackers Use AI-Powered ARTEX Framework to Automate Cyberattacks Without Relying on Zero-Day Exploits
stories.description: AI-driven ARTEX automates hacking by exploiting exposed apps, weak passwords and misconfigurations, without needing software flaws.

stories.title: European Commission Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattack Disrupted Services
stories.description: The Commission took certain services offline to contain the incident, but it has no evidence of a data breach.

stories.title: SonicWall Warns Gen 6 Firewalls Won't Get Security Patches, Even for Critical Flaws

stories.title: Ruby Patches Ruby2Shell Vulnerability That Could Lead to RCE
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-132825, the bug is a heap-based buffer overflow that could lead to remote code execution (RCE).

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw, Breach Four Devices and Reach Internal Network
stories.description: Attackers exploited Cisco Expressway CVE-2026-76466 to gain root access, compromise 4 devices, and attempt lateral movement in a Russian organization.

stories.title: Signal Restricts Screenshots to protect User Privacy from AI assistants
stories.description: Signal is restricting screenshots on iOS 27 and some Android devices to stop built-in AI assistants from reading private chats through screen capture.

stories.title: Palo Alto Confirms Java Vulnerability Impacts Privilege Threat Analytics and Remote Access Connector
stories.description: Palo Alto confirmed a critical Java flaw enabling unauthenticated RCE in Privilege Threat Analytics, Remote Access Connector, and HTML5 Gateway.

stories.title: ClamAV Patches 10 High-Severity Vulnerabilities That Could Let Attackers Crash Antivirus Scanners
